entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 1200751810900182400: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 7.8599 +/- 0.0461 mas (same row, RUWE 0.97): 127.23 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -7.698, 12.882 mas/yr. Radial velocity from No catalogued radial velocity: Gaia DR3 measures none for source 1200751810900182400 and SIMBAD lists none. Zero is assumed; a 30 km/s error moves the star by one part in 40,000 of its distance per century.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.351 +/- 0.015 solar radii from Kanodia et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-7149 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170..203K/abstract). Mass 0.344 +/- 0.03 solar masses from Kanodia et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-7149 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170..203K/abstract). Temperature 3363 +/- 59 K from Kanodia et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-7149 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 3,363 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffc384. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret (2017), A&A 600, A30 computes from PHOENIX model atmospheres for the TESS band at 3,363 K and log g 4.88 (u1 0.160, u2 0.449): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
